props.question: Do you offer an SLA?
props.answer: Yes. Enterprise plans include a 99.99 percent uptime commitment.

props.question: Can I try it for free?
props.answer: Yes. The free plan has no time limit and needs no credit card.

props.question: Where is my data stored?
props.answer: In the region you choose, encrypted at rest and in transit.

props.question: Can I export my data?
props.answer: Any time, in open formats. Your data is always yours.
